svg.title: Battery Revenue Optimizer architecture
svg.text: Retrospective backtest for a 1 MW / 2 MWh battery in SE1–SE4: spot arbitrage vs frequency reserves (FCR-N, FCR-D, mFRR)

g.text: Scheduled by Airflow, followed by dbt build
Parse, UTC keys, DST, source quirks
46 dbt tests incl. a unit test; each layer red-tested
Best strategy per zone and date
Feature branch, PR, CI green, merge
Docker Compose for the local stack
dbt build runs in CI on every PR
dbt data tests and a unit test, red-tested
sha256 check on every landed file
verify_backfill.py finds gaps in the lake
Freshness alert at 14:00 if data is late
Lambda role can only write raw/*
No SoC or endurance rules for reserves
